analysis:
The PR changes only docs/architecture/inference.md, so no code or security control changes. The changed ranges are head 25-171 (a new Nemotron Super local bridge section) and head 876-877, plus base line 729. In the two units I examined (head lines 402-1209), the only changed lines are 876-877. These lines are a cross-reference for the TemplateRenderCheck media discovery policy, pointing to the model-registry boundary doc. They do not change any security-relevant claim.

The rest of those units is unchanged context. It covers MTP, deadlines, prefix cache, MiMo and vision. Its cache statements align with T-041: the SSD cache is encrypted, and prefix reuse needs the complete checkpoint contract. I saw no statement that raises the TTL, weakens account scoping or weakens the kill switch, and no new endpoint or attack surface.

Coverage limit: the new Nemotron Super section (head 25-171) is only partly visible in the truncated patch excerpt, and it is not in these units. It describes an unregistered internal builder that accepts only pretokenized text, rejects media, tools and client prompt-cache keys, and exposes no HTTP route. Its prefix-reuse and cache-isolation claims should be checked against T-041 and T-056 (and T-028 for residual GPU data) in whichever unit contains those lines. I made no claim about those lines. I found no findings and no threat-model gaps in the examined units.
